To overcome this problem, we present an encoder-decoder model trained and evaluated on simulated TERS images of planar molecules, enabling direct prediction of molecular structures from spectral simulated data with high accuracy. Our approach demonstrates the feasibility of automating molecular structure identification from TERS images, bypassing traditional manual analysis. These findings provide a foundation for extending machine learning methods to experimental TERS datasets, potentially accelerating molecular discovery by integrating nanoscale spectroscopy with automated computational analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 尖端增强拉曼光谱（TERS）为材料发现提供了强大的工具，但其图像数据集的解释具有挑战性。为解决此问题，本文提出了一个在模拟TERS图像上训练和评估的编码器-解码器模型。该模型能够从光谱模拟数据中高精度地直接预测分子结构，展示了从TERS图像自动化识别分子结构的可行性。这些发现为将机器学习方法扩展到实验TERS数据集奠定了基础，有望通过将纳米尺度光谱学与自动化计算分析相结合来加速分子发现。

articles.title: First-principles insights into the atomic structure of carbon-nitrogen-oxygen complex color centers in silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅中碳-氮-氧复合色心原子结构的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02644v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin-active color centers are the basis of solid-state defect systems utilized in quantum technologies. Although silicon is an emerging host material for quantum defects, there is an urgent need to characterize color centers with a non-zero electron-spin ground state in this platform, in addition to the prominent T-center. In this work, we carry out first-principles calculations to identify the possible atomic structures originating the experimentally observed N-line series in silicon. We propose that the core structure of the N1 center consists of a neighboring carbon and nitrogen interstitial pair. Furthermore, we predict that more complex defects involving self-interstitial and interstitial oxygen atoms are feasible candidates for the further lines in the series. As all of these color centers are isoelectronic to the T-center, they provide a family of alternative spin qubits with emission near the low-energy telecommunication bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅作为量子缺陷的新兴主材料，迫切需要表征具有非零电子自旋基态的色心。本工作通过第一性原理计算，识别了硅中实验观察到的N线系列可能起源的原子结构。研究提出N1中心的核心结构由相邻的碳和氮间隙对组成，并预测涉及自间隙和间隙氧原子的更复杂缺陷是该系列中其他线的可行候选。这些色心与T中心是等电子的，为在低能电信波段附近发射的替代自旋量子比特提供了一个家族。
authors: Péter Udvarhelyi

articles.title: Discovery of BKT correlations in the quantum kagome compound Cs₂Cu₃SnF₁₂
articles.title_zh: 量子kagome化合物Cs₂Cu₃SnF₁₂中BKT关联的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.22481v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the microscopic properties of the kagome compound Cs₂Cu₃SnF₁₂ using ⁶³,⁶⁵Cu nuclear quadrupolar resonance (NQR). Analysis of the local hyperfine fields below the Néel temperature T_N = 20 K indicates a spin structure consistent with P2₁/n symmetry of negative vector chirality. Measurements of the spin-lattice relaxation rate T₁ ⁻¹ reveal signatures of a gapless ground state and two-dimensional Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT)-type correlations above T_N, extending over a broad temperature range of approximately 130 K in zero magnetic field. Within the same temperature range, the observed increase in the NQR linewidth is consistent with short-range chiral order recently identified by neutron scattering. Our results establish Cs₂Cu₃SnF₁₂ as a unique quantum kagome system exhibiting BKT behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用⁶³,⁶⁵Cu核四极共振（NQR）研究了kagome化合物Cs₂Cu₃SnF₁₂的微观性质。Néel温度T_N = 20 K以下局部超精细场的分析表明，其自旋结构与负矢量手性的P2₁/n对称性一致。自旋晶格弛豫率T₁⁻¹的测量揭示了无能隙基态和二维Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）型关联的特征，这些关联在T_N以上零磁场下延伸至约130 K的宽温度范围。研究结果确立了Cs₂Cu₃SnF₁₂作为一个独特的展现BKT行为的量子kagome系统。

articles.title: Bosonic Working Media in a Frustrated Rhombi Chain: Otto and Stirling Cycles from Flat Bands, Caging, and Flux Control
articles.title_zh: 受挫菱形链中的玻色子工作介质：基于平带、囚禁和磁通控制的奥托和斯特林循环
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13185v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate that flat-band engineering provides a direct route to control and optimize the thermodynamic performance of quantum heat engines. We consider noninteracting bosons on a rhombic chain lattice described by a Bose-Hubbard model in the noninteracting limit, where a magnetic flux serves as a tunable parameter that continuously reshapes the single-particle spectrum. By driving the system toward the fully frustrated Aharonov-Bohm caging regime, the band structure transitions from dispersive to completely flat, strongly modifying the thermal occupation of the modes. We show that this flux-induced spectral restructuring has clear and measurable thermodynamic consequences. In particular, the Otto cycle exhibits a significant enhancement of both work output and efficiency when operating near the caging regime. We identify the underlying mechanism as a pronounced suppression of heat released to the cold reservoir, rather than an increase in absorbed heat, revealing that flat-band formation is an effective strategy to increase work extraction. In contrast, the Stirling cycle is governed by entropy changes during isothermal, flux-driven processes, leading to greater work extraction over a broader parameter range but at lower efficiency. These results establish geometric frustration and Aharonov-Bohm caging as thermodynamic resources and show that spectral engineering via synthetic gauge fields offers a viable, experimentally accessible pathway to tailor the performance of bosonic quantum thermal machines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了平带工程为控制和优化量子热机的热力学性能提供了直接途径。研究考虑了菱形链格点上的非相互作用玻色子，其中磁通量作为可调参数连续重塑单粒子谱。通过将系统驱动到完全受挫的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆囚禁区域，能带结构从色散变为完全平坦，显著改变了模式的热占据。研究表明，奥托循环在接近囚禁区域运行时，功输出和效率都显著提高，其机制是向冷热源释放的热量显著抑制。

articles.title: Simple logical quantum computation with concatenated symplectic double codes
articles.title_zh: 级联辛双码的简单逻辑量子计算
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2195 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-08-19-2195 There have been significant recent advances in constructing theoretical and practical quantum error correcting codes that function well as quantum memories; however, performing fault-tolerant logical gates on these codes is less studied, and the protocols that do exist often require significant complexity. Building off the symplectic double construction, we investigate concatenated symplectic double codes, which have a rich set of logical gates implementable using only physical single-qubit gates and qubit relabeling. Combined with injected fold-transversal gates, the full Clifford group on a single codeblock is achieved through a functionally simple circuit. We perform circuit-level simulations of state preparation and quantum error correction on these codes and show that they have promising performance at near state-of-the-art physical error rates. As such, we argue that concatenated symplectic double codes are strong contenders as the underlying computational code on medium- to large-scale quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了级联辛双码，其特点是可以通过物理单量子比特门和量子比特重标记实现丰富的逻辑门集。结合注入折叠横向门，可以在单个码块上实现完整的Clifford群，且电路功能简单。通过对这些码的状态准备和量子纠错进行电路级模拟，结果显示其在接近最先进的物理错误率下表现出色，有望成为中大型量子计算机的基础计算码。

articles.title: Quantifying mixed-state entanglement via partial transpose and realignment moments
articles.title_zh: 通过部分转置和重排矩量量化混合态纠缠
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2194 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-08-19-2194 Entanglement plays a crucial role in quantum information science and many-body physics, yet quantifying it in mixed quantum many-body systems has remained a notoriously difficult problem. Here, we introduce families of quantitative entanglement witnesses, constructed from partial transpose and realignment moments, which provide rigorous bounds on entanglement monotones as well as entanglement dimensionality. Our witnesses can be efficiently measured using SWAP tests or variants of Bell measurements, thus making them directly implementable on current hardware. Leveraging our witnesses, we present several novel results on entanglement properties of mixed states, both in quantum information and many-body physics. We develop efficient algorithms to test whether mixed states with bounded entropy have low or high entanglement, which previously was only possible for pure states. We also provide an efficient algorithm to test the Schmidt rank using only two-copy measurements, and the operator Schmidt rank using four-copy measurements. Further, our witnesses robustly certify the quantum circuit depth in the presence of noise, as well as the Schmidt rank of mixed states. Finally, we show that the entanglement phase diagram of Haar random states, quantified by the partial transpose negativity, can be fully established solely by computing our witness, a result that also applies to any state 4-design. Our witnesses can also be efficiently computed for matrix product states, thus enabling the characterization of entanglement in extensive many-body systems. Finally, we make progress on the entanglement required for quantum cryptography, establishing rigorous limits on pseudoentanglement and pseudorandom density matrices with bounded entropy. Our work opens new avenues for quantifying entanglement in large and noisy quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一系列基于部分转置和重排矩量的定量纠缠判据，为混合量子多体系统中的纠缠单调量和纠缠维度提供了严格界限。这些判据可以通过SWAP测试或Bell测量变体高效测量，适用于现有硬件。研究利用这些判据，在量子信息和多体物理领域取得了关于混合态纠缠性质的若干新发现，包括开发了测试有界熵混合态低/高纠缠的算法，以及使用少量副本测量Schmidt秩和算符Schmidt秩的高效算法。

articles.title: Multi-purpose quantum laboratories from superconducting circuits
articles.title_zh: 基于超导电路的多功能量子实验室
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting circuits (SCs) are the cornerstone of modern quantum technology, enabling scalable computing through coherent control of macroscopic quantum states. Through a legacy that predates modern quantum computing, SCs have emerged as high-precision instruments for discovery. In this review, we highlight the role of SCs as general-purpose quantum laboratories, outlining the emerging landscape of correlated matter-circuit science. We review and unify the capabilities of superconducting quantum hardware across condensed matter, high energy and quantum information sciences. We trace the technical evolution of these architectures, illustrating how their foundational development has culminated in a toolkit for resolving the complexities of macroscopic quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本综述探讨了超导电路作为现代量子技术基石和高精度发现工具的角色。文章强调了超导电路作为通用量子实验室的潜力，概述了其在凝聚态物理、高能物理和量子信息科学中的应用前景。通过追溯这些架构的技术演进，展示了其基础发展如何为解决宏观量子态的复杂性提供了工具包。

articles.title: Hardware-Aware Compilation and Execution of Bivariate Bicycle Codes on Neutral-Atom Systems
articles.title_zh: 中性原子系统上双变量循环码的硬件感知编译与执行
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computers are noisy; without quantum error correction (QEC), deep programs fail as qubits lose information due to decoherence. Among QEC approaches, bivariate bicycle (BB) codes offer low overhead and constant-depth syndrome extraction, while neutral-atom arrays provide scalable, reconfigurable qubit layouts. However, executing BB-code primitives on neutral-atom systems requires a hardware-aware mapping that respects movement, zoning, and interaction constraints. We present Park-n-Ride, a system for compiling and executing the BB code on neutral-atom processors. Park-n-Ride introduces a module layout and movement model aligned with neutral-atom constraints, exposes a compact BB-native logical interface for compilation, and integrates scheduling mechanisms that enable efficient execution on zoned architectures. By co-designing BB-code abstractions with hardware execution, Park-n-Ride provides a practical path from qLDPC primitives to resource-efficient, high-throughput execution on reconfigurable neutral-atom arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对中性原子系统上双变量循环码（BB码）的量子纠错执行挑战，本文提出了“Park-n-Ride”系统。该系统旨在编译和执行中性原子处理器上的BB码，引入了符合中性原子约束的模块布局和移动模型，并提供了紧凑的BB原生逻辑接口和高效调度机制。通过协同设计BB码抽象与硬件执行，Park-n-Ride为在可重构中性原子阵列上实现资源高效、高吞吐量的qLDPC原语执行提供了实用途径。
